 W.P.(C) No.17347 of 2015 - P  ======================
 Dated this the 14th day of July, 2015  J U D G M E N T

The petitioner is a dealer in food grains and is aggrieved by the seizure of the food grains, by a team led by the District Supply Officer, Thiruvananthapuram, the 2nd respondent, as per Ext.P7 mahazar.

The rice stored at the petitioner's premises in plastic bags and intended to be sold in the brand name of 'Nirapara' was seized, on the suspicion that they are food grains intended for supply in the Public Distribution System (PDS).
The quantity as specified in the mahazar, was taken possession of.
2. The learned Government Pleader submits that the proceedings are now pending before the District Collector, Thiruvananthapuram.

The food grains seized is said to be kept in W.P.(C)
No.17347 of 2015 - P the premises of the 5th respondent.
3. The controversy is in a narrow compass.
The Food Corporation of India (FCI) was directed to make an inspection of the seized articles and file a report.
The report dated 23.06.2015 is produced at Ext.P11 before this Court.
It has been categorically found by the Officers of the FCI that there is nothing to conclude that the seized food grains are food grains intended for distribution under the PDS.
In such circumstance the learned Government Pleader submits that the proceedings may be directed to be concluded by the District Collector.
4. However Ext.P10 order passed by the District Collector in a similar instance assumes significance.
Earlier also the petitioners godown was inspected and goods seized which were subsequently released by the District Collector as per Ext.P10 orders.
A reading of Ext.P10 order shows that only reliance placed is on the report of the FCI as also the bills produced by the petitioner of the purchases made.

In such circumstance, on the petitioner approaching the District Collector within a week from today and producing the purchase bills to evidence the source of the seized articles, the District Collector shall verify the report made by the FCI and shall release the goods expeditiously within Karthikeyan vs The District Collector on 18 March, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197673027/
